title: Gradius Galaxies
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 1100007437 (addresses via C2 ra_notes.py)
notes: Genre: Shooter. Stage number raw (0-based likely). C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text:
Collect red capsules to move the cursor along the meter, press the power-up button to buy:
Speed -> Missile -> Double/Laser -> Option -> ? (Force field / shield)
widgets.label: Power meter

widgets.text: A shoot, B power-up, L/R missile depending on settings
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text:
Choose a weapon type at the start: different missiles, doubles and lasers.
Up to 4 Options copy your shots.
widgets.label: Loadouts

widgets.text:
Core bosses: shoot the blue core through the shield walls.
Keep 2 Speed-ups at most, too fast is deadly.
After a death, rebuild Speed first.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: A string of themed stages (volcanoes, Moai heads, high-speed corridors, a boss rush) ending in the enemy fortress.
widgets.label: Structure

widgets.text:
Red capsule = one step on the meter.
Blue capsule = smart bomb on all on-screen enemies.
widgets.label: Capsules

widgets.text: Options follow your path: lead them into position before boss fights.
widgets.label: Notes

widgets.text: Clear the final stage; the game then loops at a higher difficulty.
widgets.label: Goal
